description: This file defines the UI theme customization for the Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes composable functions for setting theme colors based on system dark mode, configuring system UI overlays, and providing color schemes to child components.

methods.name: OpenClawTheme
methods.description: Sets the application theme based on system dark mode, configures system UI overlays, and provides theme colors to child composables.

methods.name: overlayContainerColor
methods.description: Returns the appropriate container color depending on dark mode with a certain alpha in light mode.

methods.name: overlayIconColor
methods.description: Returns the color for overlay icons based on the current theme.
